description.en: The ID of the media fingerprint library from which you want to delete files.

description.zh: 需要删除的文件主键，用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多删除50个。
description.en: The primary key values of the files that you want to delete. Separate multiple values with commas (,). You can delete up to 50 files at a time.
